name: ModelVariant412_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant412_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the header-407 entry with ten trail sprites and six flares in place of the petals); for a non-negative request it selects the config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets the slot parts and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame, calling the swarm helper from the config start and the quads helper from phase 2, and fades the tint; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-429 images build the same source with VERSION_FRENCH and the palette column 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
